purpose: Teach: グローバリゼーション/投信/空母/プレーオフ/有線/セメント/プランニング/農水省
target_vocab: グローバリゼーション

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、創業時、グローバリゼーションを先見されてた
lines.en: Dad saw the global economy coming, even back then at the start.
lines.style: Measured, respectful. Voice carries the weight of memory. Slow, deliberate pacing — each phrase a small tribute. Slight pause between thoughts, as if choosing words carefully.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは投信投資にも慎重だった
lines.en: Yes. He was cautious even with investment trusts — wouldn't chase trends.
lines.style: Direct, factual delivery. Solid ground under each word. Warm but steady — not sentimental, just truthful. The tone of a son confirming what matters.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、空母型の物流網を構想された
lines.en: Dad conceived of logistics networks on a scale most people couldn't imagine.
lines.style: Quiet wonder, tinged with loss. Slow intake before speaking. Voice softens on 'imagine' — he's seeing it again in his mind's eye. Trailing-off that suggests incompleteness.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんはプレーオフのような決戦感を経営に持ち込んだ
lines.en: Yes. He brought a playoff intensity to business — every decision felt decisive, final.
lines.style: Steady, reflective tone. Not explaining, just confirming what was true. Slight emphasis on 'decisive' — acknowledging the high stakes he kept. Calm, measured pace throughout.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、有線通信の初期に投資された
lines.en: Dad invested early in telecommunications infrastructure when nobody else saw it.
lines.style: Voice carries the same quiet admiration from before. Slower pace — he's looking back. Slight breathiness on 'invested,' as if still surprised by the foresight. Trails off gently.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんはセメント業界とも提携された
lines.en: Yes. He partnered with cement manufacturers too — always thinking ahead of the curve.
lines.style: Confirming with steady respect. Voice has the texture of someone who watched his father's strategy unfold. Each phrase deliberate. Warm undertone — not just facts, but pride.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、毎年のプランニングを欠かさなかった
lines.en: Dad never missed his yearly planning cycle — it was non-negotiable.
lines.style: Softer, more reflective. 'Non-negotiable' carries quiet certainty. Slower tempo. Voice becomes almost tender — he's describing a ritual, a discipline that shaped everything. Slight trailing-off.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは農水省の検査にも丁寧に対応された
lines.en: Yes. Even with the Ministry of Agriculture inspectors — he was meticulous, respectful with everyone.
lines.style: Slower, weighted delivery. Voice carries closure — this is the final picture. Gentle emphasis on 'respectful.' Not lecturing, just seeing the man whole. Slight breath-pause before closing.
